snippet.title: Mech Havoc: The Destructive Demo - Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Check out the upcoming demo for Mech Havoc. Releasing February 7th
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3403460/Mech_Havoc_The_Destructive_Demo/

Fight your way through the endless horde of robots! Control powerful mechs armed with a large variety of weapons, including: lasers, cluster bombs, and rocket launchers. Complete high-stakes missions, upgrade your arsenal, and climb the tech tree to save the world from the attacking automatons!

Mech Havoc is an upcoming Indie, Vehicular Combat game with a large emphasis on weapon variety and environmental destruction.
